title: A Soul's Bane
start: Talk to Launa by the rift east of Varrock, just south-east of the earth altar.

recommended.t: Antipoison(m) is helpful for low-levelled players
Archaeology journal for a close teleport

kills.t: Several angry unicorns, angry bears, angry giant rats, or angry goblins

rewards.t: Access to the Tolna's rift for combat training
Anger Battleaxe, Maul, Spear and Sword overrides

steps.t: Talk to Launa who is east of Varrock and south of the path leading to Silvarea. [Chat: Accept]
Near the entrance is a set of weapons.

Only these weapons will defeat the monsters in this room. Different weapons kill different monsters. Kill monsters until the rage meter at the top of the screen is full. Certain equipment will not allow progress. To be safe, un-equip all gear except the anger weapons.

sub.t: Anger maul - kills Angry giant rat

p: The "rage level" bar increases as the player defeats the monsters.
The result of the player's extreme rage

steps.t: Enter the exit to the east to proceed.

'Look-inside' a dark hole, if the fear reaper does not show up right away move onto the next hole that has the 'look-inside' option. Move around the room in a clock-wise rotation until the fear reaper has been killed 5 times.
p: Tolna enters the dungeon with fear.

steps.t: Continue the process until you receive a cutscene.
After the cutscene, Enter the black hole on the west wall to proceed.
Start attacking a confusion beast, if you do not deal any damage immediately move onto another beast until you find the one that takes damage.

sub.t: Any confusion beast that you hit will continue to attack you, if you are low combat it is advised to continue hitting a beast until it goes away.

steps.t: Find and kill the confusion beast 5 times in total in order to proceed.
After all beasts have been killed enter the remaining confusing door for a cutscene.
Kill each of the hopeless creatures 3 times.

sub.t: Eating food will cause the hopeless creature to restore 75% of their life points.

steps.t: Cross the bridge and 'Use' the exit to proceed.
Kill all three of Tolna's heads.

sub.t: If he doesn't spawn, exit the room and re-enter.

steps.t: On the surface, talk to Tolna again.
p: Tolna returns to his human form after the player defeats him.

get_inside.text: Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.
